theme: Light theme for the customer storefront to emphasize food freshness, trust, and hygiene. Light/Dark toggle support for the Admin Dashboard.

headings.usage: Use for hero text, section titles, product titles on PDP. Apply tracking-tight for sizes above text-2xl. DO NOT use generic fonts for headings.

body.usage: Use for descriptions, metadata, standard UI elements. Use leading-relaxed for body paragraphs.

headings.usage: Functional headings for tables, metrics, and page titles.

body.usage: Clean geometric sans for maximum legibility in data-dense views.

customer_storefront.container: Max-width optimized (max-w-7xl), generous padding (px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8).
customer_storefront.grid: Bento-grid for home page category highlights. Use standard fluid grids for product listings (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Gap-6 or gap-8.
customer_storefront.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Large product imagery overlapping soft geometric shapes. Avoid standard 50/50 splits.
customer_storefront.product_cards: Image container max height constraints to avoid dominating the viewport, specifically on mobile.

admin_dashboard.container: Full width with fixed sidebar navigation.
admin_dashboard.grid: High Density Grid (gap-4 or gap-6). Every pixel utilized.
admin_dashboard.tables: Cardless design for data tables. Extend edge-to-edge within their containers with sharp 1px borders.

buttons.customer: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for main CTAs. High contrast hover states (hover:-translate-y-0.5, shadow-md transition-all).
buttons.admin: Subtle rounded-md. Purely functional. Focus rings mandatory.

cards.customer: Subtle border (border-black/5), rounded-2xl, soft ambient shadow on hover.
cards.admin: Flat solid surfaces, 1px border-border, no drop shadows. Strictly structural.

navigation.customer: Sticky header with Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px bottom border). Ensure text is fully readable. DO NOT use pure transparent.
navigation.admin: Fixed sidebar, solid background (bg-slate-900 text-white or bg-white border-r).

badges.usage: Prominent use for 'ASAP Delivery', 'Out of Stock', or 'Discount' tags. High saturation colors for visibility.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use optical clarity for glass elements in the storefront. Flat solid surfaces in the functional admin side.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px inner strokes for depth on storefront cards. Sharp borders for admin grid layouts.
visual_enhancers.motion: Storefront: Smooth entrance animations for product grids, micro-interactions on add-to-cart buttons. Admin: Minimalist, immediate feedback without distracting animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for standard text. Never use gray-on-gray for vital info.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cart toggles, checkout steps) MUST include data-testid attributes for automated testing.
accessibility.focus: Always explicit focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-primary).

category_spices.description: Vibrant Indian spices arranged in a traditional thali.

category_dry_fruits.description: Rich assortment of dry fruits and nuts.

category_rice.description: Raw, premium quality basmati rice grains.

instructions_to_main_agent: The project uses .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write React components in standard JSX/JS accordingly.
Prioritize building raw HTML + Tailwind for complex storefront layouts. Use Shadcn strictly for interactive logic (Forms, Modals, Select, Dialogs).
For the Admin dashboard, leverage Shadcn components heavily (Tables, Cards, Forms, Dropdowns) but keep them flat, cardless, and dense.
The 'ASAP' delivery option MUST be visually distinct from standard slot selections during checkout, using the Accent color.
In the Location Selector (header), prioritize a clean dropdown or a centered modal on first visit.
Use Lucide React (lucide-react) for generic icons, but consider Phosphor icons if more character is needed.
Do not use generic placeholders for images. Utilize the provided image_urls for category representations.
Implement the customer cart as a sliding drawer (Sheet component from Shadcn UI).
DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Always use a solid color or heavy glassmorphism to preserve readability.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Use 2-3x more spacing than usual.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully with backdrop filters, avoiding transparent overlays that muddy text.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties like opacity, transform, and background-color.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Left-align dense content.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 💡, 🎯, etc.) for icons.
Ensure hover states exist on all interactive elements. Static UIs feel dead.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, buttons, and navigation links for robust testing.
Always rely on optical alignment rather than strict geometrical alignment for elements like icons inside buttons.
